title: Area and integrals: quick check
intro: Four questions. Take your time, then press **Check my answers**.

questions.question: What is $\int_0^1 x\,dx$?
questions.explanation: Under $y = x$ from 0 to 1 is a triangle with base 1 and height 1: area $\tfrac{1}{2}$.

questions.question: Which is an antiderivative of $2x$?
questions.explanation: The derivative of $x^2$ is $2x$, so $x^2$ (plus any constant) is an antiderivative.

questions.question: If $f(x) < 0$ on $[a,b]$, then $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx$ is…
questions.explanation: Area below the x-axis counts as negative in a definite integral.

questions.question: Why do we write $+C$ in $\int 2x\,dx = x^2 + C$?
options: Constants have derivative 0, so any constant works
questions.explanation: $x^2 + 5$ and $x^2 - 3$ both have derivative $2x$. The $+C$ says every one of them is an answer.
